task: Chapter video-sample export (PR brief 08 / video_utils). Verified and superseded by the implementing session: the earlier monitor-authored observation was accurate; this revision confirms it, adds the frontend wiring and the now-committed spec. Wire the dead `generate_video_sample` (present-but-unwired in both v1 and v2) into a real per-chapter MP4 export.

app/engines/video_utils.py.summary: Reworked from a logo-overlay-on-black-canvas sample into a still-image + audio MP4 renderer. New helpers: clamp_duration() (->[1,MAX_DURATION_SECONDS=120], default 30), resolve_orientation() (ORIENTATIONS: square 1080x1080 / portrait 1080x1920, default square), build_video_sample_command() (ffmpeg argv: scale+letterbox-pad onto dark canvas _CANVAS_COLOR, libx264 -tune stillimage, aac 192k, -t cap, -shortest, +faststart). generate_video_sample() signature changed: param logo_path -> image_path, added orientation, max_duration default 120->30; now guards missing ffmpeg via shutil.which and returns FFMPEG_MISSING_RC=127, falls back to bundled STUDIO_LOGO_PATH (assets/logo.png resolved from source tree) when image absent. Still delegates execution to proc_utils.run_cmd_stream.

app/api/routers/chapters_assets.py.summary: New route POST /chapters/{chapter_id}/export-video (params project_id?, orientation=square, duration=30) that renders a shareable MP4 of chapter audio + project cover and returns it as a FileResponse (video/mp4) for local download — no upload. New helper _resolve_project_cover() mirrors the assembly router's cover resolution (virtual /projects/<pid>/cover/<file> -> StorageManager cover_dir, containment-checked via resolve().relative_to). Runs generate_video_sample in run_in_threadpool; maps FFMPEG_MISSING_RC->503, failure->500, out-of-bounds output path->403. Output filename encodes orientation dims to avoid square/portrait clobber.

frontend/src/api/index.ts.summary: Added api.exportChapterVideo(chapterId, {projectId?, orientation?, duration?}) -> Blob, POSTing to /api/chapters/{id}/export-video with optional query params and throwing on non-ok. The prior api.exportSample (audio-URL) is now unused by any caller (candidate for follow-up cleanup).

frontend/src/pages/Book/stages/ContentsS.summary: handleExportSample now calls api.exportChapterVideo and downloads the blob via downloadBlob (was: open audio URL). Same change applied to Book/stages/ManuscriptStage.tsx and pages/ProjectDetail/ProjectDetailPage.tsx handlers.

flow_impact: Adds a new chapter-asset export flow (chapter WAV + project cover -> local MP4 download) behind POST /chapters/{id}/export-video, surfaced by the existing per-chapter 'Export Video Sample' menu item (enabled when audio_status==='done'). Spec-backed: design-docs/specs/video-sample.md 1.0.0 (registered in specs/README.md). tests/engines/test_engines.py and tests/api/test_api_chapters_assets.py also modified/added in the same change (test-only, not mapped source).
